items.title: The Picard scheme of a curve decomposes into smooth proper pieces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter pic.tex (Picard Schemes of Curves)
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file pic.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Prove the six-part structure theorem for the Picard functor of a smooth projective curve over a separably closed field: decompose Picardfunctor into open pieces Pic^d via the chi-locally-constant lemma (perfect-lemma-chi-locally-constant-geometric); build gamma_d : Hilb^d -> Pic^d from O(D_univ) by Yoneda; deduce smoothness of dimension g from the open immersion on a nonempty open of Hilb^g plus translates covering (from the representability proof); separatedness from the group-scheme-over-field lemma; properness of the images; surjectivity of gamma_d for d >= g since every L of degree d with chi > 0 has a section, so L = O(D); properness of all pieces by translation; smoothness of gamma_d for d >= 2g-1 by identifying each fibre with Proj(Sym(Gamma(X,L)^*)) = P^{d-g} (dimension d+1-g by the vanishing lemma), then flatness (algebra-lemma-CM-over-regular-flat) and smooth fibres give smoothness.
